build: demo (offline stand-in; NOT real Supabase auth)

results.name: All 8 app pages show the nav strip with 9 destinations and a Sign out link, and exactly one marks the current page
Round trip: index -> each app page (via the index link) -> Home link returns to the hub, for all 8 pages
Tool-to-tool: every app page reaches every other app page in one click via the strip (8x7 links resolve to a served page)
Nav follows the page language: Korean and Arabic labels, RTL for Arabic, English again; hidden under print media
results.expected: en/ko/ar labels, rtl, print none, screen flex

results.name: Using the QR page's own language selector changes the nav to Korean
Sign out from each of the 8 app pages: lands on Login with the sign-in form + "signed out" notice, ?action is removed from the URL
After signing out via the nav, cloud save is refused on K-ISSB, K-RE100, EPR, Supplier, QR and Settings (table unchanged)
